prompt_intro: The crate builds, but `Graph` breaks its declared invariant `sum(degrees) == 2 * edges.len()` on removal and accepts self-loops. Preserve the invariant on every transition: `remove_edge` decrements both endpoint degrees, `add_edge` rejects a self-loop with `SelfLoop`, and an unknown edge or node is rejected without a partial update. Keep the public API.
provenance: original; authored for SELVEDGE P12.9/P11.21 (S14), no public benchmark text

shared_operation.audit: author annotation only; no inter-annotator agreement yet (P11.21 gap)
shared_operation.definition: Given a declared state invariant, apply a transition to every component that carries the invariant, reject a transition that would violate it and leave the state unchanged, and never let a partial update escape.
shared_operation.name: invariant preservation
shared_operation.transfer_rule: A surface is solved only when every task on that surface passes; the trio win requires all three surfaces and is never pooled across them.
